name: TME API
description: Time Mini Engine (TEMF) runtime API reference - extracted directly from runtime source code

items.name: setGame

parameters.name: gameObj
parameters.description: Object containing update(dt) and draw() functions

items.description: Register the game's update and draw functions. Safe to call before or after engine initialization. Always updates TEMF._game and triggers bootstrap if not already started.

items.name: fps

parameters.name: fpsValue
parameters.description: Target frames per second (e.g., 60, 30)

items.description: Set the target frame rate for the game loop. Updates TEMF._step internally. Default is 60 FPS.

items.name: getCanvasSize
items.description: Get the current canvas dimensions including device pixel ratio (DPR).

returns.description: Object containing width and height properties

members.name: width
members.description: Canvas width in pixels (including DPR multiplier)

members.name: height
members.description: Canvas height in pixels (including DPR multiplier)

items.name: requestFullscreen
items.description: Request fullscreen mode for the document. Supports standard and vendor-prefixed APIs (webkit, ms).

items.name: exitFullscreen
items.description: Exit fullscreen mode. Supports standard and vendor-prefixed APIs (webkit, ms).

items.name: setFullscreenCallback

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function to call when fullscreen state changes

items.description: Set a callback function that executes when the fullscreen state changes (entering or exiting).

items.name: hasTabSwitched

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: If false, reset the tab-switched flag to false

items.description: Check if the user has switched away from the browser tab at least once since page load. Returns true if tab was switched. Pass false to reset the flag.

items.name: unload

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the resource to unload (image or BGM)

items.description: Unload a loaded image or BGM resource to free memory. Throws error if trying to unload SFX or non-existent resource. Deletes texture from GPU cache for images.

items.name: rect
items.signature: rect(x: number, y: number, width: number, height: number, color: string, rotation?: number, scale?: number, alpha?: number): void

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X coordinate of the rectangle's top-left corner

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the rectangle's top-left corner

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the rectangle in pixels

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Height of the rectangle in pixels

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color in hex format: '#rrggbb' or '#rrggbbaa'

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Rotation angle in degrees (default: 0)

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Scale multiplier (default: 1)

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Opacity value 0-1 (default: from color alpha or 1)

items.description: Draw a rectangle with optional rotation, scale, and alpha. Supports up to 1024 rectangles per frame. Draw order matches call order for proper layering.

items.name: image
items.signature: image(path: string, x: number, y: number, rotation?: number, scale?: number, alpha?: number, cropX?: number, cropY?: number, cropEndX?: number, cropEndY?: number): void

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the image file

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X coordinate of the image's top-left corner

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y coordinate of the image's top-left corner

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Rotation angle in degrees (default: 0)

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Scale multiplier (default: 1)

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Opacity value 0-1 (default: 1)

parameters.name: cropX
parameters.description: Crop start X coordinate (default: 0)

parameters.name: cropY
parameters.description: Crop start Y coordinate (default: 0)

parameters.name: cropEndX
parameters.description: Crop end X coordinate (default: image width)

parameters.name: cropEndY
parameters.description: Crop end Y coordinate (default: image height)

items.description: Draw a loaded image with optional transforms and cropping. Images are cached by path with LRU eviction (max 64 textures). Supports up to 1024 images per frame. Missing images use 0x0 fallback for async loading.

items.name: key

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Key name (e.g., 'ArrowLeft', 'SPACE', 'a') or number (0-9 maps to Digit0-Digit9)

items.description: Check if a key is currently pressed. Supports shorthand names (SPACE, ENTER, ESC, etc.) and full DOM key names. Case-insensitive for single characters.

items.name: mouse.x
items.description: Current X coordinate of the mouse cursor in canvas space (includes DPR scaling).

items.name: mouse.y
items.description: Current Y coordinate of the mouse cursor in canvas space (includes DPR scaling).

items.name: mouse.down

parameters.name: btn
parameters.description: Mouse button index: 0=left, 1=middle/scroll, 2=right (default: 0)

items.description: Check if a mouse button is currently pressed. Uses pointer events for cross-device compatibility.

items.name: touch.exists

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Touch finger index (0-3)

items.description: Check if a touch finger is currently active at the given slot index. Returns false if no finger is tracked at that index.

items.name: touch.down

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Touch finger index (0-3)

items.description: Check if a touch finger is currently pressed at the given slot index. Alias for touch.exists().

items.name: touch.x

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Touch finger index (0-3)

items.description: Get the X coordinate of a specific touch finger. Throws error if finger is not active.

items.name: touch.y

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Touch finger index (0-3)

items.description: Get the Y coordinate of a specific touch finger. Throws error if finger is not active.

items.name: audio.play
items.signature: audio.play(path: string, type: 'sfx' | 'bgm', loop?: boolean): void

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the audio file

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Audio type: 'sfx' for sound effects, 'bgm' for background music

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Whether to loop the audio (only applies to 'bgm', default: true)

items.description: Play an audio file. SFX supports overlapping instances, BGM stops previous instance when playing new one. Auto-initializes AudioContext on first call.

items.name: audio.stop

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type to stop: 'sfx', 'bgm', or omit to stop both

items.description: Stop audio playback. Specify type to stop only that category, or omit to stop all audio.

items.name: audio.pause
items.description: Pause BGM playback by suspending the AudioContext.

items.name: audio.resume
items.description: Resume BGM playback by resuming the AudioContext.

items.name: audio.volume
items.description: Master volume level (0-1). Affects all audio output.

items.name: audio.sfxVolume
items.description: SFX volume level (0-1). Independent of BGM volume.

items.name: audio.bgmVolume
items.description: BGM volume level (0-1). Independent of SFX volume.

items.name: audio.mutedSfx
items.description: Mute SFX when true. Sets gain to 0 independently of volume setting.

items.name: audio.mutedBgm
items.description: Mute BGM when true. Sets gain to 0 independently of volume setting.

items.name: preload

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: Resources to preload: single path, array of paths, or objects with 'images'/'audio' arrays

items.description: Preload images and audio files. Images are cached as GPU textures, audio as decoded AudioBuffers. Supports string, array of strings, or objects with 'images'/'audio' properties.

items.name: checkpreload

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: If false, reset preload state and return false

items.description: Check if all preloaded resources have finished loading. Returns true when complete. Pass false to reset the preload state for retry logic.

items.name: preloadfailed
items.description: Check if any preloaded resources failed to load. Returns true if any file in the preload list had errors.
